purpose: Construct trusted RF year-source and independent register-observation context through public owner contracts, then retain immutable evidence through authenticated RF persistence.
verifiedBehavior: Fresh token actor and accepted owner checks bind exact current company identity.
Every original document is verified through Documents, retaining actual source year, content-addressed version and the Documents-owned full metadata digest.
Callers cannot provide either internal trusted context.
No-activity, formation, transfer and ordinary dividend sources require complete explicit source evidence and complete Governance enumeration.
Dividend reporting year derives from the general-meeting date while its finalization proof preserves the original Governance source year and receipt.
Pending, rejected, superseded, reversed, corrected and omitted relevant Governance evidence blocks capture.
Independent register capture accepts attached workspace corporate/accounting originals with owner-confirmed complete before/after register and registration facts.
Cash issuance and loss-covering reduction bind the exact current independently persisted register ID, version and hash to event-time before/after states from RF's shared full-year replay.
An independent observation must exist no later than Governance finalization. Every observation original is independently reverified when capturing the year source.
Capital economics and original document hashes derive from retained Governance facts, not the caller's proposed event economics.

dateRule.productInference: Map the ordinary dividend general-meeting decision date to the RF reporting year; preserve, rather than rewrite, the original Governance accounting/source year.

limits: No HTTP route, provider call, hosted change or production activation is added.
These application tests exercise owner contracts and pure persistence preparation; they are not end-to-end database or storage tests.
Documents verification proves exact bytes and metadata; owner confirmation supplies register content/provenance review. It does not automatically certify factual contents.

Cross-owner reads are point-in-time observations, not a production freshness lease. Atomic Documents retention and RF observation-currentness checks belong to the separately reviewed persistence integration.
Cash nominal increase remains explicitly blocked pending an authoritative Governance variant; the accepted full-year product scope is unchanged.
Historical fund-issued capital and post-loss distribution clearance remain separate documented gaps.
No private source contents, tokens, identities, document bytes or production company facts are included.
